The error occurred because MONTHS_FR was defined inside MetricDétailScreen but HorizontalCalendar was a separate function outside that scope. Fixed by passing months as a prop.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: MONTHS_FR variable was defined inside MetricDétailScreen component (line 105) using t() for i18n, but HorizontalCalendar was a separate function defined outside the component (lines 38-99) that tried to use MONTHS_FR on line 71

fix_applied: 1. Modified HorizontalCalendar to accept optional months prop
2. Added fallback: const MONTHS_FR = months || MONTHS_FR_DEFAULT
